mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART (member_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT CI.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, CI.cart_id AS cartId, CI.product_id AS productId, CI.package_id AS packageId, CI.quantity AS quantity, DATE_FORMAT(CI.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
CASE WHEN CI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRODUCT' ELSE 'PACKAGE' END AS itemType,
IFNULL(P.product_name, PK.package_name) AS productName, IFNULL(P.price, PK.package_price) AS price, IFNULL(P.product_status, PK.package_status) AS itemStatus, P.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, PK.package_grade AS packageGrade,
CASE WHEN CI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = CI.product_id AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = CI.package_id AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS thumbnailUrl FROM CART_ITEM CI LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON CI.product_id = P.product_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON CI.package_id = PK.package_id WHERE CI.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY CI.cart_item_id DESC

SELECT CPI.cart_package_item_id AS cartPackageItemId, CPI.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, CPI.package_item_id AS packageItemId, CPI.selected_product_id AS selectedProductId, CPI.item_role AS itemRole, CPI.additional_price AS additionalPrice, PI.quantity AS itemQuantity, PI.item_order AS itemOrder, P.product_name AS selectedProductName, P.product_status AS selectedProductStatus, P.stock_quantity AS selectedProductStock FROM CART_PACKAGE_ITEM CPI INNER JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM PI ON CPI.package_item_id = PI.package_item_id INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON CPI.selected_product_id = P.product_id WHERE CPI.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} ORDER BY PI.item_order ASC, CPI.cart_package_item_id ASC

SELECT CPE.cart_package_extra_id AS cartPackageExtraId, CPE.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, CPE.package_extra_option_id AS packageExtraOptionId, CPE.additional_price AS additionalPrice, PE.extra_type AS extraType, PE.extra_name AS extraName, PEO.option_name AS optionName FROM CART_PACKAGE_EXTRA CPE INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION PEO ON CPE.package_extra_option_id = PEO.package_extra_option_id INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA PE ON PEO.package_extra_id = PE.package_extra_id WHERE CPE.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} ORDER BY PE.display_order ASC, PEO.display_order ASC
SELECT product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, price AS price, stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, product_status AS productStatus FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT package_id AS packageId, package_name AS packageName, package_price AS packagePrice, package_status AS packageStatus FROM PACKAGE WHERE package_id = #{packageId}

SELECT PI.package_item_id AS packageItemId, PI.item_role AS itemRole, CASE WHEN PI.product_id = #{selectedProductId} THEN 0 ELSE PIO.additional_price END AS additionalPrice FROM PACKAGE_ITEM PI LEFT JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM_OPTION PIO ON PI.package_item_id = PIO.package_item_id AND PIO.option_product_id = #{selectedProductId} WHERE PI.package_item_id = #{packageItemId} AND (PI.product_id = #{selectedProductId} OR PIO.package_item_option_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1

SELECT PEO.package_extra_option_id AS packageExtraOptionId, PEO.additional_price AS additionalPrice, PE.package_id AS packageId FROM PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION PEO INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA PE ON PEO.package_extra_id = PE.package_extra_id WHERE PEO.package_extra_option_id = #{packageExtraOptionId}

SELECT cart_item_id AS cartItemId, cart_id AS cartId, product_id AS productId, quantity AS quantity FROM CART_ITEM WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND package_id IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT cart_item_id AS cartItemId, cart_id AS cartId, package_id AS packageId, quantity AS quantity FROM CART_ITEM WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND package_id = #{packageId} AND product_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART_ITEM ( cart_id, product_id, package_id, quantity, created_at ) VALUES ( #{cartId}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{quantity}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO CART_PACKAGE_ITEM ( cart_item_id, package_item_id, selected_product_id, item_role, additional_price ) VALUES ( #{cartItemId}, #{packageItemId}, #{selectedProductId}, #{itemRole}, #{additionalPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT CI.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, CI.product_id AS productId, CI.package_id AS packageId, CI.quantity AS quantity, P.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, P.product_status AS productStatus, PK.package_status AS packageStatus FROM CART_ITEM CI INNER JOIN CART C ON CI.cart_id = C.cart_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON CI.product_id = P.product_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON CI.package_id = PK.package_id WHERE CI.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} AND C.member_id = #{memberId}
